site.name: Tahir
site.tagline: I design clothing brand banners, campaign graphics and identities that make people stop scrolling.
about: I'm Tahir, a graphic designer focused on fashion and clothing brands. I turn collections, drops and seasonal sales into bold visuals for web, social and print.
My work covers promotional banners, lookbook layouts, packaging and brand identity. I like strong type, clean grids and colour that does one job well.
site.contactText: I'm open to freelance and full-time design work. Send a short brief and I'll reply quickly.

points: Design campaign banners and social creatives for clothing brands.
Build brand identities: logos, colour systems, type and guidelines.
Deliver print-ready and web-ready assets on tight launch schedules.
